pinned_manuscript_audit.literal_source:
1. An elementary short-interval divisor bound

For integer k>=2, let d_k(n) be the number of ordered k-tuples of positive
integers with product n. If I is an interval in [1,Z], Z>=2, of length Y,
then

 sum_(n in I) d_k(n)
 <= k*[Y*(1+log Z)^(k-1)+Z^(1-1/k)*(1+log Z)^(k-2)].       (E1)

Proof. For every ordered tuple choose a largest coordinate (use the first
one in a tie). If its value is v and the product of the other coordinates
is d, then v>=n^(1/k), so d<=n^(1-1/k)<=D=Z^(1-1/k).
There are at most k choices of its position. For each ordered remaining
tuple of product d, the condition dv in I permits at most Y/d+1 integers
v. Dropping the requirement that v be largest only increases the count.
Therefore the left side is at most

 k*sum_(d<=D) d_(k-1)(d)*(Y/d+1).

The elementary product expansions give, for j>=1,

 sum_(d<=D) d_j(d)/d <= (1+log D)^j,
 sum_(d<=D) d_j(d) <= D*(1+log D)^(j-1).

For the second inequality, sum the last factor with floor(D/product)
and then use the first inequality for the other j-1 factors; j=1 is
immediate. Substitution proves (E1). All endpoints and locations of I
are allowed; no coprimality condition or arithmetic progression is used.

mathematical_route_audit.ceil_verdict: VALID for a coarser alternative, NOT a proof of the literal sharp manuscript E1. For Z>=1 and R=Z^(1-1/K), ceil R<=R+1<=2R; the enlarged cutoff also enlarges logarithms. If Y>=R one can absorb with a constant depending only on K. This does not justify adding that premise to the original E1.
mathematical_route_audit.explicit_coarse_alternative: For C=1+log 2 and L=1+log Z>=1, a ceil route bounds the two terms by K*(C^(K-1)*Y*L^(K-1)+2*C^(K-2)*R*L^(K-2)). Under Y>=R this is <=3*K*C^(K-1)*Y*L^(K-1). This mathematical alternative is not installed as the sharp E1 theorem.
mathematical_route_audit.why_exact: At a maximum coordinate the existing finite proof gives dp^K<=n^(K-1). Assuming D+1<=dp makes (D+1)^K<=dp^K<=n^(K-1), contradicting the new strict condition. Hence dp<=D. No rounding loss is present.
mathematical_route_audit.strict_consumer: The new small-cover partition lemma is independent of any power cutoff. Its positive-product cancellation/image-injectivity proof is retained. The indexed cover and native tau consumers use the strict condition directly, with K>=2 and n>=1 unchanged.
mathematical_route_audit.floor_bridge: Define R=Z^(((K-1:Nat):Real)/(K:Real)). Prove R=Z^(1-1/K), R^K=Z^(K-1), and 1<=R<=Z for K>=2,Z>=1. Nat.lt_floor_add_one gives R<floor R+1, so B<=Z implies B^(K-1)<(floor R+1)^K. This fixes the insufficiency of the old non-strict D^K premise without changing the accepted core.
mathematical_route_audit.native_mean_assembly: At the genuine real cutoff R>=1 the existing sum_fouvryTau_div_le_real supplies exponent K-1, and sum_fouvryTau_le_real at order K-1 supplies exponent K-2. Both use exactly Ioc 0 floor R, identified with Icc 1 floor R. Since R<=Z, log monotonicity enlarges both logarithms to log Z, with no new constants.
mathematical_route_audit.final_written_conclusion: For K>=2, A<=B natural, Z>=2 real and B<=Z: sum_{A<n<=B} native fouvryTau K n <= K*((B-A)*(1+log Z)^(K-1)+Z^(1-1/K)*(1+log Z)^(K-2)).
mathematical_route_audit.uniformity: The explicit bound is uniform in all A,B,Z satisfying the displayed conditions. It introduces no interval-dependent constant, threshold, or target supplier. The source itself remains uncompiled.
edge_cases: K=2 gives order K-1=1 and exponent K-2=0 in the ordinary native mean; the proof preserves this case.
Z>=2 implies positive Z and 1<=R<=Z; all logarithm and rpow premises are justified. Intermediate radius results already work at Z=1.
A=B gives an empty Ioc interval with zero geometric length; no positive-length premise is added. A=0 still excludes n=0.
The geometric strict lemma itself does not need n>0, but n>0 remains required in the divisor/image partition and native-cardinality applications.
D=0 is permitted in strict finite statements. For the actual radius Z>=2,K>=2 the floor is at least one.
There is no floor substitution into the old false sufficient implication R^K<=floor(R)^K. The successor-power inequality is strict and pointed in the opposite direction.
mathematical_route_audit.remaining_endpoint_limit: All real endpoint placements and open/closed endpoint conventions of the manuscript have not been adapted. Do not claim the full manuscript endpoint-uniform E1 from the natural Ioc theorem alone.

    (hcut : n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) < (D + 1) ^ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ i : ι, deletedProduct a i ≤ D := by

theorem card_smallCover_eq_sum_deletionFibers (S : Finset (ι → ℕ)) {n D : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hprod : ∀ a ∈ S, (∏ j, a j) = n) (i : ι) :
    (S.filter (fun a => deletedProduct a i ≤ D)).card =
      ∑ d ∈ truncatedDivisors n D, (deletionFiber S i d).card := by

theorem card_le_sum_deletionFibers_strict (S : Finset (ι → ℕ)) {n D : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι)

    (hcut : n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) < (D + 1) ^ Fintype.card ι) :

theorem fouvryTau_le_truncated_divisor_sum_strict {K n D : ℕ}

    fouvryTau K n ≤ K *
      (∑ d ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun d => d ≤ D), fouvryTau (K - 1) d) := by

theorem sum_fouvryTau_interval_payment_strict {K A B D : ℕ}
    (hK : 2 ≤ K) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hcut : B ^ (K - 1) < (D + 1) ^ K) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc A B, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D,
        (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) * (((B : ℝ) - (A : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ) + 1) := by

theorem sum_fouvryTau_interval_payment_strict_split {K A B D : ℕ}
    (hK : 2 ≤ K) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hcut : B ^ (K - 1) < (D + 1) ^ K) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc A B, (fouvryTau K n : ℝ)) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * (((B : ℝ) - (A : ℝ)) *
        (∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
        ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 D, (fouvryTau (K - 1) d : ℝ)) := by

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem rpow_natCast (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (n : ℝ) = x ^ n := by simpa using rpow_intCast x n

lemma rpow_mul_natCast (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n := by
  rw [rpow_mul hx, rpow_natCast]

theorem one_le_rpow {x z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : 1 ≤ x ^ z := by
  rw [← one_rpow z]
  gcongr

theorem rpow_le_self_of_one_le (h₁ : 1 ≤ x) (h₂ : y ≤ 1) : x ^ y ≤ x := by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h₁ h₂

theorem floor_le (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (⌊a⌋₊ : R) ≤ a :=
  (le_floor_iff ha).1 le_rfl

theorem floor_eq_iff (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ⌊a⌋₊ = n ↔ ↑n ≤ a ∧ a < ↑n + 1 := by
  rw [← le_floor_iff ha, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, ← floor_lt ha, Nat.lt_add_one_iff,
    le_antisymm_iff, and_comm]

theorem lt_of_floor_lt (h : ⌊a⌋₊ < n) : a < n :=
  lt_of_not_ge fun h' => (le_floor h').not_gt h

theorem lt_one_of_floor_lt_one (h : ⌊a⌋₊ < 1) : a < 1 := mod_cast lt_of_floor_lt h

theorem lt_succ_floor (a : R) : a < ⌊a⌋₊.succ :=
  lt_of_floor_lt <| Nat.lt_succ_self _

@[bound]
theorem lt_floor_add_one (a : R) : a < ⌊a⌋₊ + 1 := by simpa using lt_succ_floor a

@[bound]
theorem le_ceil (a : R) : a ≤ ⌈a⌉₊ :=
  ceil_le.1 le_rfl

theorem ceil_lt_add_one (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (⌈a⌉₊ : R) < a + 1 :=
  lt_ceil.1 <| (Nat.lt_succ_self _).trans_le (ceil_add_one ha).ge

@[mono, gcongr, bound]
theorem pow_le_pow_left₀ [PosMulMono M₀] [MulPosMono M₀]
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : ∀ n, a ^ n ≤ b ^ n
  | 0 => by simp
  | 1 => by simpa using hab
  | n + 2 => by simpa only [pow_succ']
      using mul_le_mul hab (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hab _) (pow_succ_nonneg ha _) (ha.trans hab)

@[gcongr, bound]
lemma pow_lt_pow_left₀ [MulPosMono M₀] (hab : a < b)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n < b ^ n
  | 1, _ => by simpa using hab
  | n + 2, _ => by
    simpa only [pow_succ] using mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt_of_nonneg_of_pos
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hab.le _) hab ha (pow_succ_pos (ha.trans_lt hab) _)
lemma div_mul_cancel₀ (a : G₀) (h : b ≠ 0) : a / b * b = a := by simp [h]

theorem log_le_log_iff (h : 0 < x) (h₁ : 0 < y) : log x ≤ log y ↔ x ≤ y := by
  rw [← exp_le_exp, exp_log h, exp_log h₁]

@[gcongr, bound]
lemma log_le_log (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x ≤ y) : log x ≤ log y :=
  (log_le_log_iff hx (hx.trans_le hxy)).2 hxy

@[bound]
theorem log_nonneg (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ log x :=
  (log_nonneg_iff (zero_lt_one.trans_le hx)).2 hx

theorem sum_fouvryTau_div_le_real (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ) / n) ≤ (1 + Real.log x) ^ k := by
  have heq : reciprocalSum ⌊x⌋₊ = (harmonic ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    have hI : Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊ = Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊ := by
      ext; simp only [mem_Ioc, mem_Icc]; omega
    simp [reciprocalSum, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, hI]
  exact (sum_reciprocalTau_le k ⌊x⌋₊).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (reciprocalSum_nonneg _)
      (heq ▸ harmonic_floor_le_one_add_log x hx) _)

theorem sum_fouvryTau_le (k N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (fouvryTau (k + 1) n : ℝ)) ≤
      N * (1 + Real.log N) ^ k := by
  refine (sum_fouvryTau_le_harmonic k N).trans ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (reciprocalSum_nonneg _) (reciprocalSum_le_log _) _) (by positivity)

/-- Real-endpoint form, uniform in `x`, with the order kept explicit. -/
theorem sum_fouvryTau_le_real {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ)) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (k - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have hfloor : 1 ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by simpa using hx)
  have hlog : 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log x := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < ⌊x⌋₊ by omega))
      (Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ x))
    linarith
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ by exact_mod_cast hfloor)
    linarith
  simpa only [Nat.succ_sub_one] using
    (sum_fouvryTau_le j ⌊x⌋₊).trans
      (mul_le_mul (Nat.floor_le (by linarith)) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg hlog j)

theorem exists_deletedProduct_le (a : ι → ℕ) {n D : ℕ}
    (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι) (hprod : (∏ j, a j) = n)
    (hcut : n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≤ D ^ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ i : ι, deletedProduct a i ≤ D := by
  have hcpos : 0 < Fintype.card ι := by omega
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset ι).Nonempty :=
    Finset.card_pos.mp (by simpa only [Finset.card_univ] using hcpos)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ a hne
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  have hbound : deletedProduct a i ≤ a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := by
    simpa only [deletedProduct, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, Finset.card_univ] using
      (Finset.prod_le_pow_card ((Finset.univ : Finset ι).erase i) a (a i)
        (fun j _hj => hmax j (Finset.mem_univ j)))
  have hpower : deletedProduct a i ^ Fintype.card ι ≤ n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := by
    calc
      deletedProduct a i ^ Fintype.card ι =
          deletedProduct a i ^ ((Fintype.card ι - 1) + 1) := by
            congr 1
            omega
      _ = deletedProduct a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * deletedProduct a i :=
        pow_succ _ _
      _ ≤ deletedProduct a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hbound
      _ = (deletedProduct a i * a i) ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm
      _ = n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := by rw [deletedProduct_mul, hprod]
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (by omega) (Nat.zero_le D) (hpower.trans hcut)

theorem card_le_sum_deletionFibers (S : Finset (ι → ℕ)) {n D : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card ι)
    (hprod : ∀ a ∈ S, (∏ j, a j) = n)
    (hcut : n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) ≤ D ^ Fintype.card ι) :
    S.card ≤ ∑ i : ι, ∑ d ∈ truncatedDivisors n D, (deletionFiber S i d).card := by
  calc
    S.card ≤ ∑ i : ι, (S.filter (fun a => deletedProduct a i ≤ D)).card :=
      card_le_sum_smallCovers S hcard hprod hcut
    _ = ∑ i : ι, ∑ d ∈ truncatedDivisors n D, (deletionFiber S i d).card := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _hi
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun a => deletedProduct a i)
          (S.filter (fun a => deletedProduct a i ≤ D)) (truncatedDivisors n D) := by
        intro a ha
        obtain ⟨haS, haD⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
          ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨deletedProduct_dvd (hprod a haS) i, hn.ne'⟩, haD⟩
      rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun a => deletedProduct a i)
        (s := S.filter (fun a => deletedProduct a i ≤ D))
        (t := truncatedDivisors n D) hmaps]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      have hdD : d ≤ D := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2
      have hfiber :
          ((S.filter (fun a => deletedProduct a i ≤ D)).filter
            (fun a => deletedProduct a i = d)) =
          S.filter (fun a => deletedProduct a i = d) := by
        ext a
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
        constructor
        · intro ha
          exact ⟨ha.1.1, ha.2⟩
        · rintro ⟨haS, had⟩
          exact ⟨⟨haS, had.le.trans hdD⟩, had⟩
      rw [hfiber]
      unfold deletionFiber
      symm
      apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
      intro a ha b hb hab
      exact eraseAt_injective_of_product hn
        (hprod a (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1)
        (hprod b (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1) i hab
